get.description:
Aggregated KPIs, decision mix, call series, rankings, and budgets for the Overview page. Time range is first-class via `range` or custom `from`/`to`. See docs/api/overview.md for aggregation semantics.

If both `range` and `from`/`to` are sent, the preset wins. Custom range requires both `from` and `to`.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Preset window. Calendar-aware (`today`) uses `tz`; rolling presets are relative to now. Default: today.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Custom interval start (inclusive), ISO-8601. Must be paired with `to`. Max span 90 days.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Custom interval end (exclusive), ISO-8601. Must be paired with `from`.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: IANA timezone for `today` boundaries and labels (e.g. Europe/Warsaw).

parameters.name: bucket
parameters.description: Series granularity. If omitted, backend auto-selects (today/24h→5m, 7d→1h, 30d→1d; custom keeps ≤~300 points).

parameters.name: top_limit
parameters.description: Max items in topAgents and topTools.

200.description: Overview metrics for the resolved window

example.detail: Custom range requires both from and to; span must be ≤ 90 days.

previousStart.description: Start of the equal-length previous period used for callsDeltaPct

callsDeltaPct.description: Percent change vs previous equal-length period; null if previous period has 0 calls

denyRatePct.description: Percent of audited decisions that are deny

cautionRatePct.description: Percent of audited decisions that are caution

rateLimited.description: Count of rate_limited decisions in the window

decisionSplit.description: Prefer order: allow, caution, deny, rate_limited

callsOverTime.description: Dense series covering the full window at the resolved bucket

rules.description: Optional override; omit to use persisted rules
